name: frontend/dummy/src/AnimatedHelloWorld.jsx
explanation: This module, `AnimatedHelloWorld.jsx`, implements the requested functionality using React hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`). It manages its own visibility state. The animation logic is handled within `useEffect`, which sets up an interval to cycle through a predefined array of greetings every 1 second, only when `isVisible` is true. The component uses fixed positioning and CSS transforms to ensure perfect centering on the screen, regardless of viewport size. It exposes `handleShow` (which should be called from `App.jsx`) and an internal `handleHide` button for user control. This keeps the presentation logic encapsulated.
